test: chennai-grievance-portal-main src/lib/studio/connectors.test.ts, src/lib/thunai/stt.test.ts, src/app/api/profile/photo/route.test.ts, src/app/api/collector/sources/[id]/route.test.ts, src/lib/studio/connect.test.ts, src/lib/assistant/__tests__/decide.test.ts, src/lib/thunai/briefturn.test.ts, src/lib/map/camera.test.ts (before: 5 to 10 failures in 6 of 6 shuffled seeds on the touched files; after: 0 in 4 of 4)
root_cause: each test took state the test before it had left: one connector made in the first test of connectors.test.ts; the shared ledger singleton in stt.ts (a 429 cooled the model for later tests, spends counted across tests); mock arrays (h.written, h.calls) never emptied; the kept browser session; a heavy dynamic import and a wall-clock p95 inside the test body. PB-253: followUpMoves was tested but production kept its own copy in useMapAsk.ts, and the copy had drifted
fix: connectors.test.ts gives each test its own connector, brought to the right day by connectorThrough(); ledger.ts gets resetLedger() called around each stt test; mocks emptied in beforeEach; the session test signs in itself; decide.test.ts loads the pipeline in beforeAll; the p95 test warms up and takes the best of five rounds with the same 20 ms limit; followUpMoves takes a sameShape argument and useMapAsk.ts calls it, the test now asserts the chip case. No test was skipped, deleted or weakened
